scenario: Velocity comes from how hard a key is pressed
name: kit: a key's velocity comes from how hard it is pressed (rows F3..C5), and scales the note
note: Sine (Basic) sustains, so its level is velocity / 127. The device reads the key's carbon pill; the emulator lands it at the scripted velocity's force (CS-1's measurements). The top row (C#5..G5) is not calibrated yet and plays at 100 on the device (D-017), so it is not in this scenario.
